idea-plugin.name: Hunch
idea-plugin.description:
Every ML run, remembered: its code, config, environment, metrics and why. Your Hunch experiment journal, inside PyCharm.

  • The tree of runs, with each run's hypothesis, main metric and its curve, and your conclusion. It updates while runs train.
  • Search and filter all your runs: by hypothesis, conclusion, command, config or run id, or with filters such as is:unreviewed, since:7d or val_loss<0.3.
  • Run with Hunch: start any Python run configuration under Hunch, with a hypothesis.
  • Keep or drop a run and write its conclusion, right from the table.
  • Compare two runs, or a run with the one it came from, in the diff viewer: config, metrics and every changed file.
  • Milestones: save one when you find something worth remembering, then browse your runs milestone by milestone.

Needs Hunch 0.3 or newer in the project's interpreter: pip install sigmoid-hunch. Runs are plain files in .hunch/, and nothing leaves your machine.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.2.0

  • Search all your runs from the field above the table, by hypothesis, conclusion, command, config or run id, and filter them: is:unreviewed, since:7d, val_loss<0.3, lr=3e-4, from:a7f3 and more, or pick common filters from the toolbar.
  • Keys: Alt+Shift+H runs the selected configuration with Hunch; in the runs table, K and D keep and drop, C writes a conclusion, Shift+F6 edits the hypothesis, Enter compares and Ctrl+F goes to the search field.
  • A run Ferry runs on another machine shows as running, with the machine's name, even while your computer sleeps; its details say when Ferry last copied it home.

0.1.1

  • The Run with Hunch button now shows in the main toolbar, right after the Run widget.
  • Compare shows the command as you typed it, without the interpreter's full path.

0.1.0, the first release:

  • The Hunch tool window: the tree of runs and their details, keep, drop and conclusions.
  • Compare runs in the diff viewer.
  • Run with Hunch for Python run configurations.
  • Milestones: browse runs by milestone, and save new ones.
